title: Lazy-loading test preloads the catalog before exercising get
reasoning: The test explicitly calls ensure_loaded before get, so it passes even if get stops triggering initial catalog loading. This leaves first-use model lookup unprotected.
reproduction: Remove the lazy-loading call from ModelCatalog.get; this test would still retrieve the model loaded at line 608.
recommendation: Keep the catalog unloaded until get is called and route its default loading location to the temporary model directory.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The other visible loading tests exercise explicit loading or idempotence; this scenario also explicitly loads before lookup.
suggestedRegressionTest: Revise this scenario to assert the catalog starts unloaded, call get directly, and verify the temporary model is returned and loading occurred.

history.reasoning: The original file and test still exist, but the test moved to lines 609–634 and now implements the recommended repair: it redirects the default directory to temporary models, asserts the catalog is unloaded, calls get directly, and verifies loading and retrieval.
